name: frag
description: Fragment Retrieval and Generation. Indexes GitHub and Gitea repos and returns the smallest set of code fragments relevant to a symptom report, instead of sending the whole codebase.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: PAT with repo:read for the GitHub repositories FRAG should index.

github_default_owner.title: GitHub default owner
github_default_owner.description: Owner assumed when a reference omits it, e.g. 'github/CERBERUS-2.0'. Leave blank to always require an explicit owner.

gitea_url.title: Gitea URL
gitea_url.description: Base URL of your Gitea instance, e.g. https://gitea.example.com

gitea_token.title: Gitea token
gitea_token.description: Gitea access token with repository read access.

gitea_default_owner.title: Gitea default owner
gitea_default_owner.description: Owner assumed when a Gitea reference omits it. Leave blank to always require an explicit owner.
